name: Lazarus Hague
source:
[i]"Everyone has the potential to become a fine tree."[/i]

A priest at St. John's Seminary. He teaches pastoral theology. One of the oldest teachers. He's a very caring and compassionate man who patiently listens to any stories and never raises his voice or gives orders in a haughty manner. He's close friends with Father August despite their great difference in age, and they are often seen walking around together.

[Translated from the [url=https://pilslash.jp/product/shingaku/]official website[/url]].
